title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full timeStaff Application Security Engineerwith deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform.

Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).

Our mission is to minimize unnecessary friction and demonstrate true partnership with our provider partners, solidifying Devoted as the health plan of choice and the preferred partner for provider organizations.

In this role, the senior manager will lead the development of a new team focused on managing group escalations and centralizing issue intake by building efficient processes and effective tooling. They build out our capabilities to respond to issues, ensuring that provider concerns are addressed promptly and effectively, thereby fostering stronger partnerships and trust with our Critical Provider Organizations (CPOs). A key responsibility will be engaging directly with our critical provider groups during issue escalations. By meeting face-to-face with these providers, the manager will work to build trust and resolve issues effectively.

Additionally, by driving upstream operational initiatives, the manager will identify key pain points and collaborate with cross-functional teams to charter and implement innovative program solutions that mitigate future escalations and improve overall operational performance. This role is pivotal in fostering a culture of proactive problem-solving and continuous improvement within the new team.

  • Lead the Charge in Issue Centralization: Spearhead efforts to build a new process to centralize the centralization of provider issue intake, to improve efficiency across the organization.
  • Champion Upstream Innovations: Lead initiatives to identify, charter, and execute upstream operational improvements, proactively tackling challenges before they escalate and transforming our operational landscape.
  • Build Insight-Driven Tooling: Develop and implement tools to accelerate and scale our ability to deliver actionable insights, enhancing data visibility and empowering our ability to make informed decisions.
  • Be a Change Maker: This is an opportunity to make a real impact, ensuring our provider partners feel valued and respected while reinforcing our mission to minimize frustration and strengthen relationships.
  • Foster Strong Provider Relationships: Meet with providers to resolve escalations and deliver proactive performance insights, actively engaging to understand their needs and challenges.

Additionally, this individual needs to be able to condense complex concepts into simple explanations with clear and concise calls to action.

Desired skills and experience:

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon is a two-component security product. One component is the “sensor”, installed on endpoint client systems that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon cloud. The Cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network and can correlate malicious behavior across multiple machines, presenting our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

Join CrowdStrike and become a key leader in building the most innovative endpoint security solution in the world. Our Sensor Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining the core components of the sensor. Sensor features cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, processes, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across multiple OS and hardware platforms (e.g. Windows, macOS, Linux).

As a Senior Engineer for the Sustaining and Operations (SaO) team, you will be expected to have ownership, responsibilities, and projects related to ongoing sensor quality. SaO team duties include troubleshooting issues, investigating and proactively responding to incoming sensor telemetry, and championing development projects that will help to improve overall Sensor reliability and supportability. As an expert in this area, you will also be responsible for providing cross‑training and best practice to our other sensor engineering teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide technical leadership on the Sensor Platform development team including being generally involved with the strategy and approach for supporting an maintaining enterprise quality next‑generation Anti‑Virus and Enhanced Detection and Response Security Software.
  • Troubleshooting complex sensor issues, investigate and proactively respond to incoming sensor telemetry, and champion development projects that will help to improve overall sensor reliability and supportability.
  • Support sensor product development teams in designing and building high quality sensor software including providing cross‑training and best practice.
  • Collaborate with multi‑functional teams in various locations.

What You’ll Need:

  • Strong knowledge and understanding of C++ and Windows Operating System internals.
  • Experience working with teams to define and execute on major projects.
  • Experience working with python and test frameworks.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, partner and work effectively in a distributed team.

Bonus Points:

  • Strong background in scalable, light‑weight and highly performing systems.
  • OS system expertise for core concepts and subsystems.
  • Familiarity with other common endpoint operating systems including macOS and Linux.
  • Familiarity and experience with Agile process.
  • Knowledge and expertise in the Security landscape.

On Location is a global leader in premium experiential hospitality, offering ticketing, curated guest experiences, live event production and travel management across sports, entertainment, fashion and culture. On Location provides unrivaled access for corporate clients and fans looking for official, immersive experiences at marquee events, including the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA World Cup 2026, Super Bowl, NCAA Final Four, and more. The Accreditation Senior Manager will, under the responsibility of the Accreditation Director, manage the On Location Accreditation process for all On Location Workforce for the FIFA World Cup 2026™. This management role demands close coordination with Workforce Operations to ensure seamless access to venues and hospitality spaces across the three Host Countries and 16 Host Cities.

  • Manage OL’s account on the FIFA Accreditation platform, ensuring thorough data management and reporting to OL stakeholders

  • Oversee Workforce communications, providing clear guidelines for data submission, offering ongoing support for applications, and delivering detailed instructions for Accreditation collection processes.

  • Develop and implement the Accreditation issue resolution system, overseeing the end-to-end implementation process, technology integration, and staffing, to ensure swift and effective resolution of inquiries and minimal disruption.

  • Produce Accreditation training contents for OL stakeholders in collaboration with Workforce Operations Team.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Project Management, Communications, Business administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Strong background in large-scale event operations, demonstrating an ability to navigate complex logistics and high-pressure environments

  • Hands-on experience in Accreditation operations, specifically delivering high-volume access requirements for major events.

  • Proven track record of implementing or scaling support operations (call center, helpdesk, customer service hub, or similar).

  • Prior involvement in major sporting events is highly beneficial, with a preference for experience working with large, international teams.

  • Familiarity with FIFA's operations and working within one of the FIFA World Cup 2026™ Host Countries or Cities is highly advantageous.

Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional project management skills, with a strong focus on organization, problem-solving, and meticulous attention to detail.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting quickly to changing circumstances.

  • Customer focus, with a strong orientation toward client satisfaction, service quality and resolution speed.

  • Extensive experience working with Event Management, Candidate Management Systems, and Accreditation tools, ensuring seamless processes and data integrity.

  • Proficient in analyzing data related to access requirements, with a focus on accuracy and trends.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work autonomously in remote settings, maintaining high standards of performance and accountability.

  • A collaborative team player with a flexible, positive attitude, eager to contribute to a successful event execution.

Travel Requirements

  • It gives us a chance to ensure alignment without long-term risk on either side
  • Many of our strongest team members joined through Lean Hire and never looked back

Success in a Lean Hire isn’t about perfection; it’s about curiosity, transparency, and seeing whether we thrive working together.

Why Work at Cal.com

We’re building Cal.com not just as a product, but as a place to do great work and live a good life.

  • Earn the same salary no matter where you live
  • No standups, no micromanagement, no unnecessary calls

  • Work in your own flow; pajamas welcome

  • Proficiency in English is essential for effective communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large‑scale embedding models and transformer architectures.

10+ years’ experience deploying large, sophisticated Cloud SaaS ERP (HCM & Fins) solutions at a project and program manager level within the Diversified Industries arena.

description:
At Webflow, our mission is to bring development superpowers to everyone. As the pioneer of the Website Experience Platform (WXP), we’re redefining how teams Build, Manage, and Optimize for the web — combining visual development, powerful content management systems, AI-driven personalization, seamless hosting, and end-to-end analytics in a single, unified platform. With AI at the core, Webflow helps teams move faster, create more performant digital experiences, and scale without heavy engineering support. From independent designers and creative agencies to global enterprises, hundreds of thousands of organizations use Webflow to turn ideas into reality — and to power what’s possible on the web.

We’re looking for a Partner Manager, Reseller to help us develop and implement strategies to grow the Webflow reseller ecosystem. You'll be responsible for building strategic relationships with resellers who can extend Webflow's reach into enterprise markets, while creating scalable programs that drive mutual growth and success. You'll work cross-functionally with our sales, marketing, and product teams to identify high-value partnership opportunities, design compelling partner value propositions, and establish frameworks that enable effective co-selling and revenue generation.

About the role

  • Location: Remote-first (United States; BC & ON, Canada)

      • Zone B: $170,000 - $214,500
      • Zone C: $161,000 - $203,000
    • Canada (All figures cited below in CAD and pertain to workers in ON & BC, Canada)
      • CAD $202,000 - $256,500

For sales roles, the ranges provided are the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") ranges, meaning that the ranges include both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Reporting to the Director, Partner Account Management

As a Partner Manager, Resellers you’ll …

  • Continue to define the structure of the Webflow reseller ecosystem
  • Build acquisition and business development strategies to grow the program
  • Work cross-functionally with sales, solution engineering, product, and marketing teams to provide partners with the best tools, resources, and features
  • Identify, pursue, and acquire new partners aligned with our Ideal Sales Partner Profile (IsPP)
    • Client Logos aligned with our ICP
    • Dedicated Marketing
    • Dedicated Sales
    • Have prior experience of SaaS Enterprise partnerships such as Optimizely & Contentful
    • Full stack agency (complete delivery lifecycle capability)
    • Strategic advisors of client technology selection
    • $50k min~ project size
  • Create and lead business objectives of partner acquisition, co-sell opportunity generation, and revenue
  • Build long term collaborations and champion partner account adoption, expansion, and retention
  • Drive Partner Sourced opportunities resulting in a pipeline for our Sales Led team.

In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, at Webflow we will support you in identifying where your interests and development opportunities lie and we'll help you incorporate them into your role.

About you

Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience

You’ll thrive as a Partner Manager, Resellers if you:

  • Have 7+ years of experience in a Partner Management role, with KPIs pertaining to “Partner Sourced” pipeline
  • Have experience with partner marketing, partner programs, and/or business development
  • Excel at navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, balancing partner needs with internal priorities while maintaining momentum toward shared business objectives.
  • Are naturally data-driven, using metrics to identify growth opportunities and having difficult conversations when partner performance doesn't meet expectations.
  • Operate with structured autonomy, proactively managing your portfolio of partners without constant oversight while executing against well-defined goals.
  • Possess strong commercial instincts, quickly recognizing mutual value-creation opportunities that drive revenue for both organizations.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — actively building fluency in emerging technologies like AI to unlock creativity, accelerate progress, and amplify impact.

Our Core Behaviors

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Deliver with speed, quality, and craft. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we do so without lowering the bar.

Benefits & wellness

  • Equity ownership (RSUs) in a growing, privately-owned company
  • 100% employer-paid healthcare, vision, and dental insurance coverage for full-time employees (working 30+ hours per week) and their dependents. Full-time employees may also be eligible for voluntary insurance options where applicable in the respective country of employment

Job Title

Company

Overview

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos médicos geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg.

Qualifications

  • Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

About Us

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa.

Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem‑estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós! A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Responsibilities

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência Médica por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

About Howard University Hospital (HUH)

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

Culture of Care Statement

In an effort to improve patient safety, Howard University Hospital (HUH) supports a Just Culture. The goal is to maintain a culture for learning, safe systems and well managed behavioral choices.

Job Responsibilities

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) reports to the President of Howard University Hospital (HUH). The COO is a member of the Executive Committee and has direct responsibility for HUH ancillary and support services departments, including the laboratory, pharmacy, radiology, nutrition services, environmental services, facilities and plant operations, rehabilitation services and cardiopulmonary services. In addition to direct line operational responsibility, the COO will provide leadership support for strategic planning activities, and business development initiatives to foster growth of inpatient and outpatient services and programs. The COO will also take a leadership role to support system-wide projects and community collaborative. When needed, the COO will partner with the designated staff to completed Certificates of Need (CONs) and business development congruent with the hospital and the HUH’s strategic plans. As a member of the Executive Council, the COO will assume rotating Administrator on Call responsibilities. The COO will work to ensure that the critical success factors are achieved (i.e. Best place to work, Most extraordinary experience, Superior outcomes, Financial success for reinvestment and a growing organization vital to the community.

Ensures excellence in hospital operations by providing technical expertise, results‑oriented leadership and a working style that promotes a spirit of collaboration to ensure integration of effort and teamwork among support and ancillary department/services and clinical service areas. Ensures departments operate safety and cost‑effectively and achieve quality, safety, satisfaction and financial performance measures.

Recruits, develops and retains leadership and talented staff in assigned areas. Coaches and supports team and individual staff development. Understanding the importance of holding staff accountable for performance, as well as, comfortably and sincerely recognizes and celebrates staff and team successes.

Partners with the leadership team to review and facilitate process and operational improvements related to hospital performance, as well as to support initiatives and takes actions to expand access to care and to promote population‑based care.

Ensures high level of patient, employee and physician satisfaction.

Provides executive leadership for strategic planning including facilitating planning retreats and linking planning activities to department operations via the business plan review process.

Ensures that appropriate resources are available to facilitate excellent patient care. 10%

Provides executive leadership to promote business development, clinical growth and new program development.

Provides executive leadership for key organizational projects working in partnership with stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient planning and successful project implementations that achieve on time and on budget targets.

Shares executive team responsibilities with other Executive Council members (including: Rounding, Regulatory and Accreditation Compliance and Survey Readiness, AOC rotation, etc.).

General Direction: The incumbent exercises wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches to critical assignments.

  • Ability to work independently and handle a multi‑task environment
  • Ability to quickly gain credibility and establish the required relationships to influence and generate results; can quickly influence market partners to take action
  • High emotional intelligence, the ability to forge meaningful relationships, and success navigating diverse stakeholder groups
  • Strong communication skills: oral and written
  • A natural comfort getting into the details of operations to drive execution, along with the ability to quickly pivot between strategy and operations
  • Proficient in PC skills in a Window environment (Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint at a minimum) and email programs.

description:
Área de Laminação de Perfis Leves, é dedicada à fabricação de perfis metálicos para abastecer o seguimento industrial e serralherias. Nossos produtos são usados em diversas aplicações, como: Estruturas de construção, suportes diversos e componentes industriais. Nosso foco principal é transformar matéria-prima, fios máquinas, em produtos prontos com qualidade, segurança e eficiência.

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

description:
Engenheiro Dados SeniorTrabalho RemotoEfetivo

Join to apply for the Engenheiro Dados SeniorTrabalho RemotoEfetivo role at KMM

Descrição da vaga

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. É essa expertise que nos capacita a oferecer uma abordagem personalizada e altamente eficaz para cada cliente.

Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Engenheiro de Dados. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Engenheiro de Dados Sênior será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines e arquiteturas de dados robustas, escaláveis e seguras. Atuará em estreita colaboração com o time de dados e as áreas de negócio para garantir a disponibilidade e confiabilidade das informações utilizadas em análises e produtos de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver, orquestrar e monitorar pipelines de dados utilizando Apache Airflow, aplicando boas práticas de modularização e versionamento de DAGs.
  • Implementar rotinas de monitoramento e alertas (logs estruturados, métricas e notificações via Grafana, email, etc.).
  • Atuar na modelagem e implementação das camadas bronze, silver e gold em um Data Lake baseado em Databricks.
  • Construir e manter integrações de dados a partir de APIs REST, bancos relacionais, arquivos CSV/Excel/Parquet e filas de mensagens.
  • Desenvolver estratégias eficientes de carga incremental, controle de versionamento e catalogação de fontes.
  • Revisar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em PostgreSQL e Oracle (PL/SQL), garantindo desempenho e uso eficiente de recursos.
  • Trabalhar com object storage (S3), definindo estratégias de versionamento, compactação e organização de arquivos.
  • Garantir a observabilidade e qualidade dos pipelines, com testes unitários e de integração e documentação técnica atualizada.
  • Participar de ritos ágeis e colaborar na modelagem de tabelas analíticas voltadas a ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik).
Experiências Desejadas
  • Vivência em ambientes de dados complexos, com múltiplas fontes e alto volume de informação.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT em produção.
  • Atuação anterior com arquitetura em camadas (bronze/silver/gold) e governança de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Domínio de Python para desenvolvimento de pipelines e automações.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL (consultas complexas, tuning, índices, CTEs, particionamento, views materializadas).
  • Experiência sólida com Apache Airflow (orquestração, versionamento, monitoramento).
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados para Data Lake.
  • Familiaridade com object storage (S3 ou equivalente) e formatos otimizados de arquivo (Parquet, ORC, GZIP).
  • Prática com Git e boas práticas de versionamento de código.
Desejável (diferenciais)
  • Conhecimento em Oracle/PLSQL.
  • Experiência com Databricks ou ambientes similares (Spark, Delta Lake).
  • Noções de Docker, DBT e monitoramento com Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Formação superior em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas.
  • Certificações em cloud ou engenharia de dados (AWS, Azure, Databricks, etc.) serão consideradas um diferencial.
Informações adicionais

No KMM by nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia.

Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos Pilares Culturais e Seus Atributos São
  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo;
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina.

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação.

Esta vaga é REMOTO e CLT, com benefícios integrados: plano de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida, flex, Gympass, Zenklub, folga no aniversário.

title: OPERADOR(A) EQUIPAMENTO MOVEL I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Executar as atividades de limpeza, carregamento e apoio na rotina operacional no Pátio de Resíduos com foco nas tarefas de:

  • Limpeza e organização de áreas de armazenamento de Resíduos e Coprodutos;
  • Limpeza e organização de área de coleta seletiva;
  • Gestão das caçambas metálicas para segregação e armazenamento de Resíduos e Coprodutos;
  • Carregamento de caminhões com resíduos ou coprodutos;
  • Operação de equipamentos móveis (Empilhadeira, Escavadeira, Caminhões e Pá Mecânica);
  • Zelar pela limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos, ferramentas e instrumentos utilizados no Pátio de Resíduos, bem como manter limpo e organizado o local de trabalho;
  • Cumprir as exigências de Segurança, legislação ambiental e as normas da empresa, visando proteger a atmosfera, a água e o solo;
  • Efetuar outras atividades correlatas por orientação do superior imediato.

Cumprir as exigências de Segurança, legislação ambiental e as normas da empresa, visando proteger a atmosfera, a água e o solo;

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

title: KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!
description:
KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!

Dit jaar starten we alweer aan het zevende bestuursjaar van onze stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig. Na de successen van voorgaande jaren in India, Malawi, Zambia en Sri Lanka, gaat KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig dit jaar vol voor stichting Estrela De Fuvela in Rio de Janeiro! Daarom gaan 30 KnappeKoppen dit jaar allemaal in hun eigen stad veel geld inzamelen zodat zij een uitbreiding van een klaslokaal van Estrela de Favela kunnen realiseren!

Lana, Wat is KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig eigenlijk?
KnappeKoppen is ooit ontstaan vanuit een initiatief van studenten uit Amsterdam en Utrecht. Zij wilden graag iets terug doen voor hun stad en anderen. Uit deze mooie visie ontstond Stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig, onderdeel van het commerciële bedrijf KnappeKoppen. Vier studenten vormden in 2018 samen het eerste stichtingsbestuur. Zij begonnen in hun eigen steden met lokale acties, zoals helpen bij de Voedselbank, ouderen een mooie dag bezorgen of kerstpakketten uitdelen. Later realiseerden ze zich dat ze impact wilden maken buiten hun eigen stadsmuren. Sindsdien zet het bestuur van de stichting zich ieder jaar in voor zowel hun eigen stad als voor een mooi (jaarlijks gekozen) internationaal doel.

Niek, waar denk jij dat in Rotterdam op dit moment de meeste behoefte is aan vrijwilligers?
Ik denk dat er in Rotterdam al veel mooie initiatieven zijn die zich inzetten voor de maatschappij. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan Stichting Betrokken Student en Oma’s Soep: twee mooie voorbeelden van organisaties die werken aan verbinding tussen de inwoners van Rotterdam. Toch is er op veel gebieden nog steeds een grote behoefte aan vrijwilligers.

Wij, als KnappeKoppen Rotterdam, zouden bijvoorbeeld maaltijdpakketten kunnen maken voor deze gezinnen of meehelpen bij een van de vele locaties van de Voedselbank. Daarnaast kunnen we soep rondbrengen naar eenzame ouderen en samen met hen een kop koffie drinken.

Sanna, kun je ons meenemen in de plannen voor komend jaar? Wat gaan jullie doen en waar ligt de focus op?
We hebben superveel leuke plannen voor het komende jaar! Een deel daarvan sluit aan bij de tijd van het jaar: zo denken we aan een Valentijnsactie, wijnflessen of kerstbomen verkopen rond de feestdagen en natuurlijk hutspotpakketten tijdens Leidens Ontzet.

Sterre, jullie hebben dit jaar gekozen voor stichting Estrela de Favela. Kun je iets meer vertellen over dit goede doel en waarom juist deze keuze is gemaakt?
Estrela de Favela is een stichting die zich inzet voor kansarme kinderen in de Braziliaanse favela’s. Zij bieden onderwijs aan kinderen van 5 tot 17 jaar, waarbij niet alleen aandacht wordt besteed aan de reguliere schoolvakken, maar ook aan ‘life skills’ en sociale vaardigheden.

Joep, wat is er allemaal nodig om het project te realiseren in Brazilië, en hoe kunnen mensen bijdragen of doneren?
Zoals Sterre vertelde, zetten wij ons dit jaar in om een nieuw klaslokaal mogelijk te maken voor kinderen in de favela! Het ingezamelde geld gaat naar de bouw en inrichting van deze plek, zodat kinderen een veilige omgeving krijgen om te leren, spelen en zich te ontwikkelen.

Keet, wat hopen jij en je bestuur dit jaar te bereiken, en hoe gaan jullie dat als team aanpakken?
Dit jaar willen wij in Groningen laten zien dat je naast je studie ook echt impact kunt maken, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk studenten te betrekken bij onze acties, want hoe meer mensen meedoen, hoe groter het verschil.

Tot slot, Naomi! Hoe ga jij al deze besturen bijstaan dit studiejaar?
Dit jaar heb ik de eer om al deze fantastische KnappeKoppen te begeleiden als manager en te ondersteunen met zowel de lokale acties als natuurlijk het grote project in Rio de Janeiro voor Estrela de Favela waar Sterre jullie al meer over heeft verteld!

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

Pessoa engenheira de dados senior remoto

Join to apply for the Pessoa engenheira de dados senior remoto role at Netvagas

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia, este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Pessoa Engenheira de Dados que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco! Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento formado por um time de pessoas incríveis, com ideias inovadoras, possuímos um ambiente descontraído e muito espírito colaborativo. Promovemos em nosso dia-a‑dia um ambiente de desenvolvimento, onde os Atlantes são o nosso maior foco, por isso um dos nossos valores mais fortes é a Valorização de Pessoas. Não é à toa, que estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking do GPTW.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções eficientes para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações novos ou existentes.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de sistemas complementares que melhorem a disponibilidade de dados para a equipe do cliente.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações de alta prioridade simultaneamente, adaptando‑se às mudanças de prioridades.
  • Identificar e interagir com as equipes do cliente para aprofundar o conhecimento das fontes de dados e tecnologias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando‑se regularmente com os gerentes do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos‑chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e à nível de produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados, especificamente soluções de dados baseadas em nuvem, incluindo a capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencialmente) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência no design, construção e otimização de pipelines e plataformas de dados em larga escala utilizando:
  • Frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos, por exemplo: Apache Spark, Apache Flink ou tecnologias similares baseadas em MapReduce.
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data, por exemplo: HDFS, YARN ou equivalentes em nuvem como S3, EMR.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho, por exemplo: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect.
  • Formatos de tabela de data lake modernos, por exemplo: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi.
  • Mecanismos de consulta SQL distribuídos para data lakes, por exemplo: Trino/Presto.
  • Experiência na criação de soluções para adquirir e persistir novas fontes de dados para uso por cientistas de dados e analistas.
  • Experiência no uso de serviços baseados em nuvem, como AWS ou GCP, para transferência, processamento e armazenamento de dados.

Idioma

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.

Desejável

  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede, autenticação, criptografia e outras tecnologias que permitem uma comunicação de rede segura e eficiente.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento em tempo real, como Kafka, Kinesis ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de competências essenciais de gerenciamento de dados, incluindo governança, segurança e qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de integração de dados (Pentaho, OWB/ODI, SSIS, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de exploração de dados (Jupyter Notebook, iPython, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de design comuns no desenvolvimento de software (MVC, MVVM, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias como Hadoop, Hive, Cassandra e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento prático de sistemas de controle de versão de software (Git preferencialmente).

Vem ser Atlante!!!

Vem ser Atlante!!!

Diversidade e Inclusão

No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos inegociáveis. Como instituto dedicado à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, valorizamos e incentivamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA. Nossa missão é promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, buscando a equidade de oportunidades e o respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico‑racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo‑sexual e de pessoas com deficiência, voltado para a defesa e valorização dos direitos humanos. Atualmente, o Atlântico possui uma subárea dedicada à diversidade e inclusão, inserida na área de Pessoas & Cultura. Essa subárea trabalha em colaboração com o Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão e com os grupos de afinidades, que são compostos por pessoas voluntárias e têm como propósito oferecer um espaço seguro para a troca de vivências, a representatividade e a construção de ações afirmativas.

Impacto Social

O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão do Atlântico investe em ações de voluntariado com foco no impacto social positivo por meio do Grupo de Afinidade de Justiça Social. Nós nos concentramos em apoiar organizações do terceiro setor e projetos de impacto social que trabalhem com os públicos que são contemplados pelos pilares do Atlântico. Em 2022, lançamos nosso primeiro projeto voltado para a capacitação de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social. O projeto‑piloto foi realizado na Comunidade de Ancuri, em parceria com a organização Visão Mundial e a ONG Associação Santos Dias, e formou 40 jovens em Lógica de Programação Básica.

title: OPERADOR(A) TREFILA I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Programa Pertencer – Gerdau

A Gerdau está sempre em busca de formas de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro. Por isso, em parceria com a Firjan e com certificação do SENAI, desenvolvemos o Programa Pertencer , uma iniciativa de capacitação profissional voltada exclusivamente para mulheres e pessoas com deficiência.

Para nós, “Pertencer” significa mais do que estar em um lugar onde a diversidade é respeitada, é também perceber que ela é, de fato, valorizada.

Objetivo do programa

O objetivo do programa é capacitar mulheres e pessoas com deficiência interessadas em ingressar no ambiente industrial da empresa . Essa é uma porta de entrada para a companhia e visa habilitar novos profissionais para atuar na indústria, não sendo exigida experiência prévia .

Público-alvo:

  • Pessoas com deficiência;
  • A partir de 18 anos;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Preferencialmente residentes da Zona Oeste do RJ, Itaguaí ou Seropédica , nas proximidades da Usina Cosigua .

Local:

Usina Cosigua – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

✨ O que buscamos:

  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Senso de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Proatividade, espírito colaborativo e autonomia.

O que oferecemos:

  • Assistência médica SULAMERICA ou UNIMED Nacional (sem carência);
  • Pronto atendimento virtual Hospital Albert Einstein;
  • Assistência odontológica;

  • Benefício farmácia, fisioterapia e dentista;
  • Previdência privada;

  • Programa +Cuidado (apoio psicológico e social).

  • Triagem dos requisitos;
  • Entrevista inicial;

  • Entrevista com a Área de Pessoas e líder da área operacional;
  • Visita à área;
  • Exames admissionais;
  • Entrega da documentação;
  • Admissão.

DIVERSIDADE É O QUE NOS MOVE.

Para nós, a diversidade e a inclusão são valores fundamentais . Entendemos que pessoas, independentemente da idade, características físicas ou individuais, devem se sentir seguras e representar na Gerdau o extrato real da sociedade.

Seguiremos valorizando a diversidade e promovendo a inclusão , buscando de forma intencional a participação de mulheres e pessoas com deficiência para desenvolver novos talentos e aumentar a equidade na Gerdau.

Na Gerdau, diversidade e inclusão são compromissos reais . Todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas, sem distinção de gênero, idade, raça, religião, orientação sexual, nacionalidade ou deficiência .

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

About the Job

The QA Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance function across Tether Data. This role ensures that product releases meet defined quality standards through the development and execution of test strategies, frameworks, and automation. The QA Lead works closely with the teams, Dev‑Ops and Product to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.

The QA Lead serves as the quality champion within Tether Data and plays a key role in shaping the overall testing culture and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Drive QA Strategy: Establish and continuously refine the overall QA vision, goals, and strategy to align with product and engineering objectives, balancing manual and automated testing approaches.

  • Plan and Manage Testing Activities: Oversee test planning, prioritization, and execution across projects. Ensure test coverage aligns with business impact, release timelines, and risk assessment.

  • Mentor and Guide QA Engineers: Provide technical and procedural guidance to QA Engineers, fostering skill development in both manual and automation testing. Conduct regular reviews and coaching sessions.

  • Ensure Quality Governance and Standards: Define QA processes, templates, and best practices to standardize testing across teams. Maintain consistency in documentation, defect management, and reporting.

  • Collaborate with Cross‑Functional Teams: Work closely with product managers, developers, and DevOps to ensure quality is embedded throughout the SDLC. Participate in planning and other ceremonies where applicable to provide support and guidance.

  • Oversee Test Automation Strategy: Guide the design, maintenance, and optimization of automation frameworks. Ensure automation coverage is effective, scalable, and well‑integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage Test Environments and Data: Coordinate environment setup, data preparation, and version control to ensure test consistency and reliability across manual and automated executions.

  • Monitor and Report on Quality Metrics: Define and track key QA KPIs (e.g., defect density, test coverage, pass rate, release readiness). Use insights to drive continuous improvement.

  • Facilitate Release Readiness and Risk Assessment: Lead go/no‑go decisions based on test outcomes, quality metrics, and known issues. Communicate quality status and risks clearly to stakeholders.

  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.

  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).

  • Proven experience in leading the design and execution of QA strategies across multiple projects.

  • Strong proficiency in planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and coordinating testing activities across teams.

  • Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud environments and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent QA leadership certification.

Important information for candidates

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

The company’s flagship technology, PhotonAssay™, steps around centuries-old chemistry-based assay methods to deliver true ‘atom-counting’ analysis for the measurement of gold and other high-value metals. With successful global installations, Chrysos is taking PhotonAssay™ to customers around the world – Chrysos could take you to places that you might not have even imagined yet. There’s opportunity around every corner and the support to help you achieve your goals.

The Maintenance Specialist, with support from the rest of the team, will be providing firsthand technical support service to ensure the smooth running of Chrysos PhotonAssay™ equipment.

This permanent full-time role supporting the Suriname site.

  • Assisting in the installation and commissioning of new installations.
  • Preparing fault records for statistics and reporting.
  • Assisting with Root Cause Analysis of faults (to improve reliability) and safety (to prevent incidents that could lead to injury or damage).
  • Assisting in the training of new Maintenance Specialists.
  • Scheduling maintenance events for site.
  • Performing other on-site duties delegated by Maintenance Manage.
  • Supporting the development of a strong WHS culture.
  • Safety first mindset always.

Who you are:

  • Demonstrated experience in maintaining technical equipment.
  • Strong customer service ethos and critical thinking skills.
  • Customer Service and Field Service experience in the mining or mineral sector (or related) processing industries.
  • Able and willing to travel and work within Americas region and overseas, including at remote locations such as mine sites.
  • Proven ability with proficient written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficient using software platforms for reporting to include the MS Office suite of products.

  • Direct experience in one or more of the following areas: electrical wiring and safety, power distribution, mechanical maintenance, and repairs; basic electronics; metalworking; engineering drawing and design.

Who We Are (Our Values)

  • Safety is a Non-Negotiable - Safety isn’t just a value — it’s our way of life. It’s about creating a culture where physical and psychological safety are top priorities. We speak up, challenge assumptions, and hold ourselves accountable to protect one another.
  • One United Team – We thrive on trust, respect, and empathy. By embracing each other’s unique contributions and supporting one another, we build collective strength to solve problems, celebrate wins, and grow together.

  • Always Improving – We are curious, courageous, and committed to progress. Every challenge is an opportunity to grow, and every step forward builds toward something extraordinary. Making or doing things better isn’t just a goal — it’s our mindset.

description:
Overview

PharmaLogic is the fastest-growing SPECT & PET radiopharmaceutical solutions provider and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with radiopharmacies across North America. We are passionate about expanding the power of radiopharmaceutical technology to provide transformative diagnostic and therapeutic agents to patients from bench to bedside. PharmaLogic offers you an exceptional opportunity to join our dynamic team!

Job Overview: The Corporate Quality Assurance Specialist (CQAS) is integral to upholding the company's commitment to quality standards. This role ensures stringent compliance with industry regulations and standard operating procedures. As a central figure in Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs (QARA) department, the CQAS supports site Quality Assurance Specialists (QAS). They bridge the gap between regulatory requirements, standard operating procedures, internal policies, and daily operations, championing both efficiency and excellence. As regulatory landscapes shift, the CQAS proactively positions the company at the forefront of compliance and best practices.

Responsibilities

  1. Act as the central point of contact, providing Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs support and guidance to on-site QA teams. Offer guidance, expertise, and troubleshooting support as needed to ensure optimal operations.
  2. Perform internal audits for US-based PET manufacturing locations. Analyze audit findings, ensure timely resolutions, and work to prevent recurrences. Collaborate with Operations and QARA Departments to maintain consistent quality standards.
  3. Drive continuous improvements within the Quality Management System (QMS). Engage in consolidation and optimization of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensure teams are ready and equipped to implement new procedures, and foster collaboration to amplify the effectiveness and efficiency of PET operations.
  4. Manage the initiation, review, and finalization of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) changes. Ensure they align with industry best practices and regulatory guidelines. Lead corrective action planning and correspondence efforts post-audits (external and internal), ensuring efficient and effective resolutions.
  5. Collaborate with on-site QA teams to review and approve investigation reports (NCR/MCR/OOS/Deviations), trending results (including environmental monitoring data), and CAPA to assure adequate corrective actions are implemented.
  6. Assure the on-site QA teams are following the SOPs, documentation and filing practices, and internal policies and work with PET Operations to identify need for additional training or other personnel requirements.
  7. Assist with Regulatory Affairs activities such as Annual Reporting, Field Alert Reports (FARs), FDA 483 responses, and other incidents that require FDA notification.
  8. Ensure vendor qualifications are up-to-date and standardized throughout PET network, as appropriate.
  9. Assist in QA review of sponsor-related documents with on-site QA, Technical Operations, and PET Operations teams for areas of concern; ensure site awareness of sponsor requirements.
  10. On-call availability for overnight support.
  11. Other related duties as assigned by the QARA Department.

Qualifications

Job Requirements / Skills / Education:

  • 3 years' experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Regulatory Affairs preferred
  • 2 years' experience in a PET manufacturing setting adhering to 21 CFR 212 preferred
  • Technical Writing skills
  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis
  • Experience with Gas Chromatography (GC) and HPLC is a plus
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and detail orientation
  • Proficiency in communication, analysis, problem-solving, and teamwork mentality
  • Flexibility for varying shifts
  • Willingness to travel up to 75%

Physical and Intellectual Requirements

Manual dexterity for manipulating small items; regularly lift at least 50 pounds throughout each shift and to be able to lift 75 pounds on occasion. Able to handle standing, walking and sitting for 4+ hours with limited rest intervals; good eye-hand coordination; fair eyesight (with or without correction lenses); normal hearing in at least one ear (hearing range of 20 Hz to 20 kHz); ability to analyze situations, set priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining attention to detail in a fast-paced and dynamic environment; effective organizational skills; a commitment to continuous learning; an ability to work well both independently and as part of a team.

Oferecemos uma solução completa para gestão de cobranças, pagamentos, antecipações de recebíveis e atendemos mais de 200 mil clientes divididos entre profissionais autônomos, microempreendedores individuais (MEI) e grandes empresas.

Nosso sonho começou em 2010, em Joinville/SC e acreditamos que o céu não é o limite para o nosso crescimento. Não é à toa que atualmente nosso time está em vários cantos do Brasil! Mais de 800 pessoas sonham junto com o Asaas, de forma colaborativa, inovadora, eficiente, com autonomia e liberdade para voar alto.

Na sede, temos free food e, para as famílias, oferecemos auxílio creche, programa de apoio parental e licença maternidade e paternidade estendida.

Para educação e crescimento: além de um ambiente de desafios e muito desenvolvimento, temos uma plataforma de treinamentos e disponibilizamos auxílio educação que subsidia 70% de mensalidades de graduações e idiomas, bem como a compra de cursos e livros, para que nosso time nunca pare de aprender.

Communication and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support communication and relationship‑building with rural landowners participating in the project, answering questions and organizing necessary information to ensure engagement.
  • Assist in organizing meetings, trainings, and workshops with landowners and partners, including logistical support and activity documentation.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Flexible, with frequent field presence in projects located in Southern Bahia and Espírito Santo.
  • Involvement in both administrative tasks and field activities.
  • Regular in‑person participation required for meetings, field trips, and other activities, both nationally and internationally, including travel to remote regions within Brazil.
  • Preferably based in the project implementation region – Bahia or Espírito Santo.

Qualifications

Required

  • Technical and/or practical knowledge in ecology, conservation, restoration, and carbon projects.
  • Experience with project monitoring and data collection platforms.

  • Experience in preparing technical reports and meeting minutes.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Finance team. This role is responsible for the end-to-end accounts receivable cycle, ensuring timely and accurate invoicing, efficient collections, and proper reconciliation of accounts. The ideal candidate will be experienced in managing client relationships, resolving billing discrepancies, and supporting month‑end close activities in a fast‑paced, international environment. This is a remote position open to candidates based in Brazil, reporting to the Accounts Receivable Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, issue, and record invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Manage collections, proactively following up with clients to ensure payments are received within agreed terms.
  • Record and apply customer payments in the financial/ERP system, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal policies.
  • Maintain and reconcile AR sub‑ledgers, intercompany accounts, and assigned balance sheet accounts.
  • Analyze and resolve account discrepancies by collaborating with sales, operations, and other internal teams.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate aging reports and collection status summaries.
  • Assist in the month‑end close process, including journal entries and account reconciliations.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and reports.
  • Perform light general accounting duties and assist with other finance tasks as needed.
  • Participate in continuous process improvement and cross‑training initiatives.
  • Build and maintain cooperative working relationships with both internal stakeholders and external clients.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Technical or university degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of hands‑on experience in Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections, preferably with direct customer contact.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, bank reconciliations, and general ledger processes.
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Basic knowledge of Accounts Payable processes is an advantage.
  • Spanish: Fluent; English: Intermediate level required.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills, with a professional and courteous approach.
  • Excellent organizational and time‑management abilities; able to handle high volumes and prioritize effectively.
  • Analytical and problem‑solving mindset, able to investigate and resolve discrepancies efficiently.

Trabalhando para nós

Na Cyncly, chamamos nossa equipe de OneCyncly, um reflexo de como atuamos juntos como um só time, unidos por nosso propósito: impulsionar negócios que dão vida aos espaços. Nossa força vem da diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e habilidades – e prosperamos quando trabalhamos com abertura, confiança e respeito.

Aqui, você fará parte de um grupo de colegas que assumem responsabilidades, resolvem problemas e focam em gerar impacto. Valorizamos a curiosidade, acolhemos novas ideias e enxergamos os erros como oportunidades de aprendizado. Você terá liberdade para trabalhar de forma flexível e autônoma, com o apoio de colegas e líderes comprometidos com o seu desenvolvimento.

Celebramos as diferentes formas de contribuição e incentivamos todos – de todas as origens – a trazerem sua autenticidade para o ambiente de trabalho. Porque, quando colaboramos, nos desafiamos e compartilhamos conhecimento, construímos algo melhor juntos.
